verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing says users can query the fleet in plain language and receive ML-driven task recommendations that people approve, and that orchestration assigns jobs to robots. That is the closest match to the story. However, the natural-language input is framed as asking 'what's happening', not as commanding a task, and nothing documents the platform planning and executing a task from a natural-language instruction. missing for 10: documented natural-language task specification, automatic plan generation from that instruction, documented end-to-end execution of an approved plan, technical docs beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can express a robot task in natural language and have the platform plan and execute it

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
Assigns the right job to the right robot — regardless of who built it — using operational history and live data
